name: Micro Operator
description: A tiny operations cockpit for follow-ups, contacts, status, and message drafts that shows how anyone can grow a custom business app.
permission_rationale: The app stores only its own lightweight operations records and can open Live App Studio when the user chooses to make a personalized copy.

ai_context.original_prompt: A built-in Starter App demonstrating a small custom operations app for non-technical users.
